decisions.reason: Document capture fits the firm's electronic document workflow direction, and the growing firm has the slack to carry it, though its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises doubt about how well it is doing.

Email and fax conversion builds on core fax and messaging skills at low marginal cost, and there is no clear shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources, despite its lower visibility.
This low-cost feature is embedded in the established fax business and supports regulated customers, so dropping it would free few resources.
Demand for sandbox threat protection keeps rising and it anchors the security portfolio, so keeping it fits the firm's aspirations even after the multi-engine scanner was withdrawn.
